instruction: 找到我们给我family项目生成logo的skill，然后生成项目logo，包括各种页面，背景，底纹。其中，mewth是一个可爱小猫咪头像，颜色重新选择，美短品种，偏心设计的logo；fundly全新生成，是一个见多识广的企鹅拿着望远镜，偏心设计；clip是一只螳螂，可爱头部特写，偏心设计；以上动物类都需要保持碎片化风格。dreamro是游戏类，采用拟物的高品质物品，无须碎片化，内容是古典武器，背后是盾牌，全面有弓箭，剑和魔法杖。跳过人工review图片步骤。
nameResolution: The owner typed mewth; the existing repository and requested fourth catalogue entry are nocoo/meowth.
checkpoint: Owner-delegated raw-image acceptance for this named batch; inspect each exact returned image and record its hash before finishing.
publication: Local only; no push or deployment.
verificationInstruction: 添加完不必部署，不必验证，验证我来手动进行。
siteVerification: Deferred to the owner; no standalone checks or browser windows. Normal commit hooks stay enabled.
sourceAdoption: Source identities remain preserved; finished drawings are local catalogue previews.
correctiveInstruction: clip螳螂不如原来鸵鸟，还是沿用原来吧，重新生成避免阶段，注意镜头感和偏心原则。
correctionInterpretation: Return to the liked original ostrich; regenerate with natural framing to avoid hard truncation. The existing batch waiver remains in force because the correction does not request a new manual checkpoint.
